User: I would usually pair it with something like if it's spicy, then I don't really need any sauce. If it's not spicy, to be honest, if it's just fried chicken like bone-in chicken, I don't oftentimes have a sauce. Maybe occasionally some buffalo sauce or so. I do like having fries, although fries adds additional calories. So sometimes I might opt just for more chicken as opposed to having fries. And I usually do get a soft drink. And soft drink, I would get like a Diet Coke or a Diet Pepsi.
Agent: Thank you for sharing your usual pairings: buffalo sauce if it's not spicy, fries (though sometimes you prefer more chicken), and a diet soft drink.

Now, thinking about the opposite, what would you absolutely never pair with your favorite fried chicken, and why?
